investment_policy_en:
The fund is a dynamically managed portfolio invested in a range of assets around the world, with the aim of delivering a total return (combined income and capital growth) of 5-10% on average per year over any three-year period, while applying environmental, social and governance (ESG) criteria. The fund manager follows a highly flexible investment approach, with the freedom to invest in different types of assets. The approach combines in-depth research to determine the value of assets over the medium to long term, with analysis of investors’ emotional reaction to events to identify investment opportunities.

The fund gains access to assets directly and indirectly through derivatives. The fund invests in securities that meet the ESG criteria, applying an exclusionary approach as described in the prospectus. The recommended holding period of this fund is three years.

In normal market conditions, the fund’s expected average leverage – how much it can increase its investment position by borrowing money or using derivatives – is 250% of its net asset value.
